title.en: Amplitude and period of a sine wave

concept.hr: Amplituda je visina titraja, perioda njegovo trajanje, a f = 1/T
concept.en: Amplitude is how far a sine swings, the period how long it lasts; f = 1/T

summary.hr: Dva klizača mijenjaju amplitudu (0 do 100 %) i periodu (1 do 10 s) sinusnog titraja na oscilogramu; stranica označava a, T i poluvale i računa f = 1/T.
summary.en: Two sliders set the amplitude (0 to 100 %) and the period (1 to 10 s) of a sine on an oscillogram; the page marks a, T and the half-waves and works out f = 1/T.

what.hr: Aplet applet_sinus_amplitude_und_periode.html (skripta: DL9MJ, 2024) i tekst odjeljka o amplitudi i periodi (50ohm.de, hrvatski prijevod)
what.en: The applet applet_sinus_amplitude_und_periode.html (script by DL9MJ, 2024) and the text of the amplitude and period section (50ohm.de, Croatian translation)

changes.hr: Prilagođen simdeck kitu i nacrtan bez vanjskih biblioteka, preveden na engleski, označeni amplituda, perioda i poluvali, dodani predlošci
changes.en: Adapted to the simdeck kit and drawn without outside libraries, translated into English, the amplitude, period and half-waves marked, presets added
